name: Rancho San Diego
demographics: Rancho San Diego attracts a predominantly middle to upper-middle class demographic, with the 3-mile trade area showing an average household income of $144,470 and median household income of $114,825. The center serves a family-oriented suburban population of approximately 60,000 residents within 3 miles, with a daytime population of over 61,000, indicating strong employment in the area. The trade area encompasses 20,745 households within 3 miles, with shoppers typically seeking value-oriented retail and convenient everyday shopping options. The demographic profile skews toward established families and working professionals who prioritize accessibility and practical shopping experiences.
description: Rancho San Diego is an attractively landscaped open-air shopping center located at 2516 Jamacha Road in El Cajon, California, serving the greater San Diego metropolitan area. This well-maintained community center spans 98,316 square feet of gross leasable area and offers ample parking with a ratio of 5.11 spaces per 1,000 square feet, ensuring convenient access for shoppers. The center is anchored by Ross Dress for Less, a popular off-price retailer that draws consistent traffic, complemented by a diverse mix of smaller specialty stores and restaurants that cater to the everyday needs of the surrounding community. Strategically positioned in the Rancho San Diego neighborhood, the center serves a prosperous trade area with an average household income of $144,470 within 3 miles and a population of nearly 60,000 residents. Managed by Kimco Realty Corporation, one of North America's largest publicly traded owners and operators of open-air shopping centers, Rancho San Diego benefits from professional property management and a commitment to maintaining an inviting shopping environment for the local community.
summary: Rancho San Diego is an attractively landscaped open-air community shopping center in El Cajon featuring Ross Dress for Less as its anchor tenant, along with a variety of smaller stores and restaurants. The 98,316 square foot center serves a prosperous suburban trade area with excellent parking and convenient access for everyday shopping needs.
